name: numfit
description: Javascript library for numerical interpolation and extrapolation.
author: Buca Hajdini

scripts.release:check: npm run docs:api && npm run test:types && npm test && npm run test:consumer && npm run test:browser && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.build: node ./node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild src/index.js --bundle --minify --platform=browser --log-override:empty-import-meta=silent --outfile=build/Numfit.min.js && node ./node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=browser --log-override:empty-import-meta=silent --outfile=build/Numfit.js && node ./node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=build/Numfit.module.js && node ./node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild src/ParallelWorker.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=build/Numfit.worker.js && node ./node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild src/MeshWorker.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=build/Numfit.mesh.worker.js
